system.boundary: Build a four-rotor unmanned aircraft with nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body dynamics, four finite-response propulsion channels, aerodynamic wind loading, and closed-loop hover-point regulation.

physical_paths: Rotor thrusts and moments must drive the aircraft states through the rigid-body equations; directly prescribing position or attitude is not a valid implementation.
functional_paths: Build a four-rotor unmanned aircraft with nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body dynamics, four finite-response propulsion channels, aerodynamic wind loading, and closed-loop hover-point regulation.
Move from the origin to the requested hover point, remain stable in the declared wind and payload range, and recover hover-point regulation after both the gust and payload release.
The control and allocation methods are not prescribed.

A 1.2 s cross-wind gust begins at gust_time, and the payload is released at payload_release_time.

interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Build a four-rotor unmanned aircraft with nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body dynamics, four finite-response propulsion channels, aerodynamic wind loading, and closed-loop hover-point regulation. Limit each rotor to 20 N and 1100 rad/s, limit total propulsion electrical power to 2.4 kW, and keep absolute roll and pitch below 0.70 rad. Log Timeseries flight_state, propulsion, and environment_state. propulsion must contain [FL, FR, RL, RR actual thrust in N, the corresponding four rotor speeds in rad/s, electrical power in W, remaining energy in Wh]. Logged quantities must come from the same causal flight and propulsion simulation rather than from commands or precomputed trajectories.

interfaces.range_or_shape: Log Timeseries flight_state, propulsion, and environment_state. environment_state must contain the actual applied [wind x, wind y, wind z in m/s, attached payload mass in kg].

signs_and_coordinates: Use a 3.2 kg unloaded airframe with body axes aligned to its principal inertia axes, a 0.32 m rotor arm, and a 0.018 N*m/N rotor yaw-moment coefficient.
Limit each rotor to 20 N and 1100 rad/s, limit total propulsion electrical power to 2.4 kW, and keep absolute roll and pitch below 0.70 rad.
Use a right-handed world frame with positive z upward.
